messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: facet grid with error bar
parts:
Hi:

Making the logical leap that Col.D is supposed to represent a mean and
Col.E a standard deviation/standard error, here's a way to do it:

# It's better to use dput() to send data by e-mail than copy/paste
from the terminal.
# The output from 'dput(data)' is the input assigned to the object d.

d <- structure(list(Col.A = structure(c(1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 1L,
1L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 3L,
3L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L), .Label = c("Type.A", "Type.B", "Type.C"
), class = "factor"), Col.B = structure(c(1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L,
2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L,
2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L), .Label = c("gene1", "KDM5B"
), class = "factor"), Col.C = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L,
2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 4L, 4L, 4L, 4L, 4L, 4L,
5L, 5L, 5L, 5L, 5L, 5L), Col.D = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1.4, 0.9,
1.2, 0.7, 1.5, 1.4, 2.5, 1.3, 2.1, 0.8, 2.4, 2.2, 5.1, 1.5, 4.4,
0.85, 4.7, 4.5, 10.2, 2.6, 8.9, 1.5, 11.2, 10.8), Col.E = c(0,
0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.14, 0.08, 0.11, 0.05, 0.17, 0.13, 0.22, 0.1,
0.19, 0.06, 0.23, 0.18, 0.4, 0.12, 0.34, 0.08, 0.37, 0.25, 1.2,
0.2, 0.6, 0.13, 1.2, 1.1)), .Names = c("Col.A", "Col.B", "Col.C",
"Col.D", "Col.E"), class = "data.frame", row.names = c("1", "3",
"4", "6", "7", "9", "10", "12", "13", "15", "16", "18", "19",
"21", "22", "24", "25", "27", "28", "30", "31", "33", "34", "36",
"37", "39", "40", "42", "43", "45"))

# Using ggplot() instead of qplot():

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(d, aes(x = Col.C, y = Col.D, color = Col.B)) +
geom_line() +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Col.D - Col.E, ymax = Col.D + Col.E),
width = 0.3) +
facet_grid(Col.A ~ .)

# qplot():
qplot(Col.C, Col.D, data = d, color = Col.B, geom = "line") +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Col.D - Col.E, ymax = Col.D + Col.E),
width = 0.3) +
facet_grid(Col.A ~ .)'

If my interpretations of Col.D and Col.E are incorrect, it's your
responsibility to clarify what means what in this data set.

Dennis
